malicious_evidence: SANS binds this exact 5011-byte script to a ClickFix-delivered malware installer. Triage independently identifies the same submitted SHA-256 and records commands creating an Apple-looking cache directory, killing com.apple.update, attempting payload retrieval, invoking sed to remove shell-history entries and cleaning temporary artifacts.
legitimate_tool_review: Purpose-built ClickFix malware installer with concealed payload staging and attempted history removal. This hash covers the script; genuine Bash, curl, sed, macOS components and separately hashed payloads are excluded.
limitations: SANS reports delivery on November 11; the delivery timezone and exact UTC date/time are unavailable, so the UTC delivery field is empty. Any adjacent UTC date remains within this review's seven-day window. The article was published November 13; Triage submission was November 15. A public Triage report was retrieved through alternate HTTP access after initial access failed. Its Linux sandbox differs from macOS: payload download failed and Mach-O execution, credential theft and wallet draining were not demonstrated. The entry covers the installer only. Creation and victim first-infection times and current availability were not verified.
